description: Executable Candidate reproduction of MiaAI-Lab's physically tested one-DGX-Spark DeepSeek V4 Flash profile: native compact NVFP4 KV, 384K single-request context, DSpark K5, CUDA graphs through 24 rows, and 0.94 memory utilization. Memory follows the creator's settings: GPU memory utilization 0.94, MiaAI-Lab's start.sh default at fdcd538f (line 75: 256K needs the extra ~1.2 GiB over 0.93, and the launch needs at least 0.94 × 121.63 = 114.3 GiB free host RAM). Mia's 121.63 GiB total matches this Spark's 121.69 GiB vLLM view, so the fraction carries over unchanged. The earlier 0.83 came from the 2026-10-11 offline memory fit (#1176), not from a hardware run. The declared peak is the admission maximum, an estimate until the run measures it.
title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 Mia SparkInfer single Spark
